Best Talismans in Elden Ring: Top Endgame Talismans for Every Build

2026-07-27•14 min read

Talismans are among the most powerful customization tools in Elden Ring, providing passive bonuses that can dramatically enhance your build's effectiveness. While many players focus on weapons and armor, the right talisman combination can be the difference between victory and defeat in challenging encounters. This guide covers the best talismans for every build archetype, where to find them, and how to optimize your talisman slot management for maximum effectiveness.

Top Tier Universal Talismans

These talismans are so powerful that they see use across nearly every build type, regardless of playstyle or stat distribution.

Radagon's Soreseal

Effect: Boosts Vigor, Endurance, Strength, and Dexterity by 5 levels each, but increases damage taken by 15%

Location: Fort Faroth, Dragonbarrow

Radagon's Soreseal is arguably the most powerful talisman in the game for builds that benefit from multiple stat boosts. The +5 to four core stats is equivalent to spending 20+ stat points, allowing you to reach crucial breakpoints much earlier in your playthrough. The increased damage taken is a significant drawback, but skilled players can mitigate this through better positioning and dodging. Best for: Quality builds, Strength/Dexterity hybrid builds, and early-mid game power spikes.

Erdtree's Favor +2

Effect: Boosts maximum HP, stamina, and equip load

Location: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar in the Mountaintops of the Giants

Erdtree's Favor is the quintessential defensive talisman, providing substantial boosts to your survivability and flexibility. The +2 version (upgraded via NPC questline or found in late-game areas) offers the most significant bonuses: +5% max HP, +5% max stamina, and +7.5% equip load. This allows you to wear heavier armor for better poise and damage negation while maintaining medium roll. Best for: All builds, particularly useful for melee builds that need to balance offense and defense.

Great-Jar's Arsenal

Effect: Greatly increases maximum equip load

Location: Dropped by the Great Jar in Caelid after completing his three-container challenge

Great-Jar's Arsenal is essential for builds that want to wear heavy armor without sacrificing mobility. The massive equip load boost allows you to maintain medium roll while wearing some of the game's heaviest armor sets, significantly improving your damage negation and poise. Best for: Strength builds, Faith builds with heavy incantations, and any build prioritizing survivability.

Best Talismans for Melee Builds

Rotten Winged Sword Insignia

Effect: Greatly increases attack power with successive attacks

Location: Dropped by Millicent after completing her questline and choosing to aid her

The Rotten Winged Sword Insignia is the premier talisman for aggressive melee builds. It provides escalating attack power bonuses based on consecutive hits: +10% after 3 seconds of attacking, +15% after 5 seconds, and +20% after 7+ seconds. This stacks with other damage buffs and weapon skills, making it incredibly powerful for fast weapons and builds that can maintain constant pressure. Best for: Dexterity builds, bleed builds, and any build with fast-hitting weapons.

Claw Talisman

Effect: Enhances jump attacks

Location: Found in the Gaol Cave in the Weeping Peninsula

While seemingly niche, the Claw Talisman boosts jump attack damage by 15%, making it valuable for builds that incorporate jump attacks into their rotation. Jump attacks have large hitboxes, can't be easily blocked, and deal significant poise damage, making them excellent for opening up enemies. Best for: Strength builds, colossal weapon builds, and players who enjoy aggressive playstyles.

Shard of Alexander

Effect: Greatly enhances skill (Ash of War) power

Location: Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after completing his questline in multiple locations

Shard of Alexander boosts weapon skill damage by 15%, making it essential for builds that rely heavily on Ashes of War. Skills like "Bloodhound's Fang," "Square Off," and "Prelate's Charge" see massive damage increases, often becoming your primary damage source. Best for: Builds using damage-focused weapon skills, Intelligence builds using "Adula's Moonblade" or "Comet Azspell."

Best Talismans for Magic Builds

Moon of Nokstella

Effect: Increases memory slots

Location: Found in Nokstella, Eternal City, in a chest after solving a complex puzzle

Moon of Nokstella adds two additional memory slots, allowing you to equip more spells simultaneously. This is invaluable for Intelligence builds that need access to multiple sorceries for different situations—offensive spells, utility spells, and defensive spells. The flexibility it provides often outweighs pure damage-boosting talismans. Best for: Pure Intelligence builds, hybrid caster builds, and players who value spell variety.

Graven-Mass Talisman

Effect: Enhances sorcery potency

Location: Found in the Sellia Crystal Tunnel, guarded by multiple enemies

Graven-Mass Talisman boosts all sorcery damage by 8%, making it a straightforward damage increase for pure sorcerer builds. While not as flashy as some other talismans, the consistent damage boost applies to every spell you cast, making it reliable and effective. Best for: Pure Intelligence builds focused on sorcery damage.

Radagon Icon

Effect: Shortens spell casting time

Location: Found in the Raya Lucaria Academic Temple, requiring a complex traversal

Radagon Icon reduces spell casting speed, allowing you to cast sorceries and incantations faster. This is particularly valuable for builds using slow but powerful spells like "Comet Azspell" or "Stars of Ruin," as it reduces the vulnerability window during casting. Best for: Builds using slow, high-damage spells, PvP builds that need faster cast times.

Best Talismans for Faith Builds

Flock's Canvas Talisman

Effect: Enhances incantation potency

Location: Purchased from the Hermit Merchant in the Altus Plateau

Flock's Canvas Talisman boosts all incantation damage by 8%, similar to Graven-Mass but for Faith-based spells. This applies to offensive incantations like "Black Flame Blade," "Lightning Spear," and dragon cult incantations, making it essential for pure Faith builds. Best for: Pure Faith builds, hybrid Faith/Strength builds using incantation buffs.

Godrick's Great Rune (as Talisman)

Effect: Boosts all attributes by 5 levels (when activated with a Rune Arc)

Location: Obtained after defeating Godrick the Grafted

While technically a Great Rune, Godrick's functions similarly to a talisman when activated. The +5 to all stats is incredibly versatile, benefiting every aspect of your build. When combined with a Rune Arc, this provides a massive temporary boost that lasts until death. Best for: All builds, particularly useful for boss fights and challenging encounters.

Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman

Effect: Greatly reduces physical damage taken

Location: Found in the evergaol in the Mountaintops of the Giants

Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman reduces physical damage taken by 20%, making it the best pure defensive talisman in the game. This is invaluable for Faith builds that need to get close to enemies to apply buffs or use melee weapons. Best for: Melee-Faith hybrid builds, tanks, and builds prioritizing survivability.

Best Talismans for Arcane Builds

Marika's Soreseal

Effect: Boosts Mind, Arcane, and Faith by 5 levels each, but increases damage taken by 15%

Location: Found in the Deep Siofra Well, requiring complex navigation

Marika's Soreseal is the Arcane equivalent of Radagon's Soreseal, providing massive stat boosts to the three most important stats for Arcane builds. The +5 to Arcane significantly increases status effect buildup and discovery, while the Mind boost allows for more spell casts. Best for: Pure Arcane builds, bleed builds, and builds focused on status effects.

Prince of Death's Pustule

Effect: Increases Arcane by 8

Location: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the Prince of Death's Throne area

Prince of Death's Pustule provides a flat +8 to Arcane without any drawbacks, making it a safe and reliable choice for Arcane builds. While not as powerful as Marika's Soreseal in terms of raw stat boosts, the lack of increased damage taken makes it more accessible for cautious players. Best for: Arcane builds prioritizing safety over maximum damage output.

Kindred of Rot's Exultation

Effect: Increases attack power when poison or rot is in the vicinity

Location: Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight in the Shunning Grounds

Kindred of Rot's Exultation boosts your attack power by 20% when poison or Scarlet Rot is active in the area. This synergizes incredibly well with bleed builds that also use rot or poison weapons, as well as builds that can inflict status effects on themselves safely. Best for: Bleed/rot hybrid builds, builds using the "Rotten Breath" incantation.

Talisman Slot Management

You can unlock up to four talisman slots throughout the game:

  • First Slot: Available from the start
  • Second Slot: Obtained from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold after acquiring two Great Runes
  • Third Slot: Obtained from Finger Reader Enia after acquiring four Great Runes
  • Fourth Slot: Obtained from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Morgott, the Omen King

Slot Priority: For most builds, prioritize universal talismans like Radagon's Soreseal and Erdtree's Favor in your first three slots. Use the fourth slot for build-specific talismans or situational swaps for specific bosses.

Optimal Talisman Loadouts by Build

Quality Build (Strength/Dexterity)

  • Radagon's Soreseal
  • Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
  • Erdtree's Favor +2
  • Shard of Alexander (for weapon skills) or Dragoncrest Greatshield

Pure Intelligence Build

  • Moon of Nokstella
  • Graven-Mass Talisman
  • Radagon Icon
  • Radagon's Soreseal or Erdtree's Favor +2

Pure Faith Build

  • Flock's Canvas Talisman
  • Radagon's Soreseal
  • Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
  • Erdtree's Favor +2 or Godrick's Great Rune

Arcane/Bleed Build

  • Marika's Soreseal
  • Kindred of Rot's Exultation
  • Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
  • Prince of Death's Pustule or Claw Talisman

Tank Build

  • Great-Jar's Arsenal
  • Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
  • Erdtree's Favor +2
  • Radagon's Soreseal or any defensive talisman

Conclusion

Talismans are a crucial component of build optimization in Elden Ring, offering passive bonuses that can dramatically enhance your effectiveness in combat. By understanding which talismans work best for your build archetype and managing your talisman slots wisely, you can maximize your damage output, survivability, and overall versatility. Whether you're a melee warrior, a powerful sorcerer, a devout cleric, or a master of status effects, the right talisman combination will elevate your Tarnished to new heights of power.
